weak_coverage_handling: Gemini Vision second opinion receives 70% weight; offline confidence capped at 0.70 for cotton foliar diseases.

ood_guard.action: Reject as unclear/non-leaf image and advise farmer to retake closer photo.

intended_use: Sovereign on-device and edge foliar crop disease diagnosis for smallholder farmers across BRICS nations.
bias_and_limitations: Model trained primarily on PlantVillage laboratory imagery with uniform backgrounds. Field performance on outdoor leaves with shadows, dust, or co-occurring nutritional stresses requires ensembling with Gemini Vision and extension officer confirmation. Never presents diagnosis as 100% certain.
